items.title: Does profile-driven ACPF provide qualified operating points?

source.label: 2025 AC model verification

metricDefinitions.label: Does profile-driven ACPF provide qualified operating points?
metricDefinitions.definition: Numerical convergence, profile preservation, and operating-capability qualification are checked separately.

caveats: No OPF was used. The baseline annual run uses ordinary Q-unlimited PV control.
The 157 failed annual hours also remained unresolved after 314 flat/previous-voltage retries; this is not an infeasibility proof.
Generator capability bounds are assumptions. Thermal overloads are excluded from the convergence gate.
The single slack generator supplies losses; non-slack real-power profiles and loads are preserved.

rows.check: Separate Q-limit sensitivity converged, out of 7

items.title: How closely do loads match NYISO?

source.label: 2025 AC model verification

metricDefinitions.label: How closely do loads match NYISO?
metricDefinitions.definition: The 11 zonal totals are preserved after the declared synthetic power scaling; within-zone bus shares remain fixed.

caveats: Zonal agreement is a construction identity. Substation-level allocation is not observed for 2025.
NYISO grid load is net of behind-the-meter solar and demand response.
External regional loads follow the NY load shape; generator profiles are source-informed reconstructions.

rows.measure: Largest zonal reaggregation difference, public MW

methods.code: For each hour and zone: sum(model bus PD) / gamma - public zonal load. gamma = 0.30012075175285535.

items.title: How closely do the interface diagnostics match?

source.label: 2025 AC model verification

metricDefinitions.label: How closely do the interface diagnostics match?
metricDefinitions.definition: Seven inherited zone cuts compared on 8494 equation/profile-qualified hours.

caveats: Exact physical P-32 membership, meter terminals, and the inherited numeric-as-MW convention remain unestablished.
These are diagnostic errors, not certified physical flow accuracy. The case is synthetic.
The AC/DC comparison also changes engineering parameters and charging/reactors; it does not isolate AC-loss effects.

methods.code: MAE = mean(abs(predicted - observed)). WAPE = 100 * sum(abs(predicted - observed)) / sum(abs(observed)). Only aggregate model MW is divided by gamma.

source.label: 2025 AC model verification

metricDefinitions.label: Which cable classifications are established?
metricDefinitions.definition: The current 40 cable-like AC rows have different evidence levels; four overhead-classified rows conflict with cable-corridor evidence.

caveats: The 40 rows are network equivalents, not a certified count of physical cables.
Historical utility and project evidence does not establish every circuit identity or burial ampacity.
Y49-associated rows 309 and 310 do not prove two physical Y49 circuits.

items.title: Why is the AC bus count larger?

source.label: 2025 AC model verification

metricDefinitions.label: Why is the AC bus count larger?
metricDefinitions.definition: The full AC model restores reduced-out terminals and adds numerical line sections, without adding demand or generation.

caveats: Electrical node count is not physical substation count.
The Dover device node is present only after its dated change.

methods.code: 148 + 43 restored nodes + 1 dated Dover node + 75 numerical nodes = 267; the 75 comprise 73 overhead-section nodes and 2 cable-section nodes.
